hero.title: Your hassle-free hosting for RimTUB
hero.descr: Forget about hours of server setup and configuration. RimTUB Hosted is everything you need to launch a powerful Telegram bot in just a few minutes. Simply register, top up your balance, complete a quick and simple setup, and your userbot is already running.

card1.title: Security you can trust
card1.descr1: When it comes to your bot and data, there can be no compromises.
card1.descr2: Each userbot runs in a Docker container — an isolated environment completely separated from other users and the rest of the system. Think of Docker as an impregnable fortress: one container — one userbot. They don't see each other, can't access each other's data, and have no connection to the outside world. This is the pinnacle of security.
card1.descr3: Many hosting providers simply give you space on a server and hope for the best. We guarantee complete isolation at a level used by major corporations and banks.

card2.title: Simplicity without compromise
card2.descr1: RimTUB Hosted uses {0} Pterodactyl Panel — a professional server management tool designed for people, not IT specialists.
card2.descr2: You don't need to deal with server intricacies. No need to write commands in the console. No need to understand how it all works inside. Pterodactyl is designed precisely to hide complexity and show only what you need — an intuitive interface where everything is obvious and simple.

card3.title: RimTUB — software worth using
card3.descr1: RimTUB is a powerful and user-friendly open-source Telegram userbot that's easy to customize. Everything you need is already built-in, and to expand capabilities, you simply install the necessary modules. Easy to launch, flexible to configure, and completely under your control — RimTUB is designed to do more with less effort.

card4.title: Support from the creator
card4.descr1: You're not communicating with faceless tech support or copy-paste responses. You're communicating with the developer himself, the person who created both RimTUB and RimTUB Hosted, and knows everything down to the finest details.
card4.descr2: Prompt and quality assistance isn't a promise, it's a standard.
card4.descr3: Have a question? Need help with setup? Running low on resources? Need a custom module?
card4.descr4: Don't hesitate to reach out — support is always here to help.

steps1.title: Register with the bot
steps1.descr1: Message the {0:RimTUB Hosted}, press /start, review and accept the user agreement.

steps2.title: Create a Pterodactyl account
steps2.descr1: In the bot, click on Pterodactyl account management. If you don't have an account yet, you'll immediately proceed to the creation process. Enter your email. You'll receive an email with a confirmation code — enter this code back in the bot.
steps2.descr2: Why is this needed? To ensure the email is actually yours and that it works. This is important for the next step.

steps3.title: Set up a password in Pterodactyl
steps3.descr1: Immediately after creating an account in the bot, you'll receive an email about account creation. Click the {0:"Setup your account"} button and set a strong password.

steps4.title: Create a RimTUB server
steps4.descr1: Return to the bot, click Manage RimTUB → Create.

steps5.title: Create a Telegram bot
steps5.descr1: While installation is in progress, open Telegram and find {0}
steps5.descr2: Copy the token (123456:ABC-DEF…) — you'll need it later.

sub.descr3: Come up with a name for your bot (for example, RimTUB_<your_nickname>_bot)
sub.descr4: Set a link for the bot

sub.descr6: Important: enter /setinline, select your bot and write any text (for example, asdfjwekjdsf)

steps6.title: Launch your userbot
steps6.descr1: After loading, you'll receive a five-digit confirmation code in Telegram. In the console, enter this code (type it in the {0} {1:Type a command} field).
steps6.descr2: If you have a cloud password set on your Telegram account, enter it.
steps6.descr3: Repeat for all accounts (if there are multiple).
steps6.descr4: Wait for everything to start up — and you're done! Your userbot is running.

steps7.descr5: The first boot will take a couple of minutes — this is normal, everything needed for RimTUB to work is being installed.

accordion1.title: Can I use multiple accounts?
accordion1.descr: Yes, the system supports multiple accounts on one userbot. Basic plan resources are enough for 4 to 6 accounts, depending on installed modules. If you need more, contact support.

accordion2.title: What if I don't have enough resources?
accordion2.descr: Contact support, and we'll increase resource allocation personally for you.

accordion3.title: Can I order a custom module?
